notes.title: Dragon Boat Festival Activities
notes.content:
Dragon Boat Festival Rebate Event

Dear players, in order to welcome the Dragon Boat Festival, the editor has specially secured a large number of benefits for everyone!

During the event (event start time (June 4, 2024 at 4 pm)):

 A single recharge of 6 yuan can get an additional (Xianqiong Golden Silkworm King*1, West Lake Vinegar Fish*2, Dayu Lingdan*1)

A single recharge of 30 yuan can get an additional (Name Change Card*1, Cultivation Pill*50, Skill Transcription Book*10, Marching Pill*10)

A single recharge of 328 yuan can get an additional (Achievement Order*10, Guardian Beast*1, Dye*10, Mount·Xiaohu*1, Supreme·Vast Spirit Box*1)

A single recharge of 648 yuan can get an additional (Legend·Vast Spirit Box*1, Supreme·Qiyun Artifact Box (Immortal)*1, Rare·Qiyun Tianwen Sword Box*1, Erha*1 (3 days), Advanced Transformation Pack*10, Random Part·Fashion Box (3 days), Quantity: 1)

The above activities can be participated repeatedly, and the activities will end on June 14, 2024! Don't miss it

 ps: A single recharge of 128 can get a 10,000 voucher. (Long-term validity, they don't let me say it yet)
